encoder.attention_output_policy: upstream_equivalent_embedding_only; per-layer attention matrices are not stacked because OFRA does not consume them

normalization_scope: Task-0 train shards only; frozen before Task-0 pretraining

exposure_prior_diagnostic.interpretation: diagnostic exposure-prior score; not calibrated posterior
exposure_prior_diagnostic.P_N_source: actual examples used by family loss across epochs
exposure_prior_diagnostic.focal_caveat: does not correct focal alpha/gamma or negative-pool covariate shift; the score is diagnostic, not a calibrated posterior

derivation.positive_population: all class train-shard rows once per epoch
derivation.negative_candidate_pool: other current-task train rows plus frozen exemplars from prior tasks
derivation.zero_negative_steps: exact cumulative-floor schedule used by train_family

monitoring.purpose: persist exact decision inputs for separately versioned offline prediction-flip, explanation-drift, and ETG analyses
monitoring.integrity: SHA-256 for every JSON/NPZ artifact; fail closed on mismatch

router_comparison_design: pass 1 fits the cap reservoir and matched-refines it in original stream order; uncapped copies final cap centroids/counts/lambda; pass 2 refines only rows not selected by the cap reservoir; classes no larger than the cap are identical
negative_sampling: all positives plus fresh without-replacement negatives, at most 4 per positive

training_sampler.task0_pretraining_batch_composition: natural-frequency cumulative quotas over independent per-class block cursors; within-batch deterministic shuffle
training_sampler.positive_semantics: every positive row exactly once per epoch
training_sampler.negative_semantics: exact uniform without-replacement subset via sequential hypergeometric block allocation
training_sampler.locality: shuffle shard order, block order within shard, and rows within block

exemplar_selection.scope: auditable approximation over reservoir candidates; not exact full-class farthest-first
